items.docs: The request delivers all available markets as a list of MarketIDs.

params.name: marketId
params.description: Market identifier code as specified in ISO 10383.

items.docs: The request delivers all available trading days for the selected market as a list of dates (YYYYMMDD).

params.name: marketId
params.description: Market identifier code as specified in ISO 10383.

params.name: date
params.description: Trading day in the format  YYYYMMDD

items.docs: The request delivers a list of all available products for the selected market and trading day as a list of MarketSegmentIDs.

params.name: marketId
params.description: Market identifier code as specified in ISO 10383.

params.name: date
params.description: Trading day in the format  YYYYMMDD

params.name: marketSegmentId
params.description: Unique product identifier or product pool identifier on T7

items.docs: The request delivers a list of all instruments for the selected market, trading day and MarketSegmentID as a list of SecurityIDs.

params.name: marketId
params.description: Market identifier code as specified in ISO 10383.

params.name: date
params.description: Trading day in the format  YYYYMMDD

params.name: marketSegmentId
params.description: Unique product identifier or product pool identifier on T7

params.name: securityId
params.description: Unique security identifier on T7

params.name: mode
params.description:
Define the output format for the response.
Mode options: * `reference` (default) - Shows a list of the referencing IDs * `detailed` - Shows a list of messages including their details

params.name: limit
params.description: Max number of elements in the response.

params.name: from
params.description:
Starting time for the time interval filter.
Format: Nanoseconds since 1970 (EOBI TransactTime)

params.name: to
params.description:
Ending time for the time interval filter.
Format: Nanoseconds since 1970 (EOBI TransactTime)

params.name: ApplSeqNum
params.description:
Filter by application sequence number.
(Multiple values must be separated by comma)

items.docs: The request delivers a list of the available transaction times for the selected market, trading day, MarketSegmentID and SecurityID as a list of TransactTimes.

info.name: Retrieve list of application sequence numbers or list of packets

params.name: marketId
params.description: Market identifier code as specified in ISO 10383.

params.name: date
params.description: Trading day in the format  YYYYMMDD

params.name: marketSegmentId
params.description: Unique product identifier or product pool identifier on T7

params.name: securityId
params.description: Unique security identifier on T7

params.name: transactTime
params.description: Transaction time as nanoseconds since 1970

params.name: mode
params.description:
Define the output format for the response.
Mode options: * `reference` (default) - Shows a list of the referencing IDs * `detailed` - Shows a list of messages including their details

params.name: MsgSeqNum
params.description:
Filter by message sequence number.
(Multiple values must be separated by comma)

params.name: TemplateId
params.description:
Filter by template identifier.
(Multiple values must be separated by comma)

items.docs:
"The request delivers a list of the available application sequence numbers for the selected market, trading day, MarketSegmentID, SecurityID and TransactTime as a list of ApplSeqNums."
If mode is set to 'detailed', the request returns a list of packets including their respective messages and available details. For a detailed description of the different message types please refer to the T7 EOBI documentation.

items.docs:
The request delivers a list of the available message sequence numbers for the selected market, trading day, MarketSegmentID, SecurityID, TransactTime and ApplSeqNum as a list of MsgSeqNums.
If mode is set to 'detailed', the request returns a list of messages and available details. For a detailed description of the different message types please refer to the T7 EOBI documentation.

items.docs: The request delivers the details of the message identified by the selected MarketID, trading day, MarketSegmentID, SecurityID,TransactTime, ApplSeqNum and MsgSeqNum combination. The message details consist of all fields specified in the T7 EOBI documentation for the respective message type. For a detailed description of the different message types please refer to the T7 EOBI documentation.
